description: This file is a shell script that contains test cases and setup scripts for testing Git's binary diff and apply functionalities, including handling of binary files, applying patches, and detecting corrupt patches.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test case expecting it to succeed.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, for testing error conditions.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files.

methods.name: test_might_fail
methods.description: Runs a command where failure is acceptable.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
